title: SDGBiasBench: Benchmarking and Mitigating Vision–Language Models’ Biases in Sustainable Development Goals

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on multiple-choice and regression tasks related to Sustainable Development Goals (e.g., poverty, infrastructure access, human capital) across varying input views (question-only, text-context, image-only, full multimodal). Bias is measured by detecting modality imbalance and pillar-conditioned directional defaults (systematic optimistic, conservative, or pessimistic predictions) when models rely on ingrained language priors rather than grounded visual evidence.
